name: Dynamic Object Embedding in Static Scenes
aliases: Lightweight Dynamic NeRF Modeling via Local Deformation Field
definition: A process to integrate dynamic advertising objects into static NeRF scenes by ensuring perspective consistency through spatial alignment and joint rendering with alpha blending.
summary: Dynamic Object Embedding in Static Scenes uses a lightweight local deformation field to model motion in specific objects, reducing parameters by 95% compared to traditional dynamic NeRFs.
